string-array.name: tip_android_focus_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Digital Wellbeing and parental controls.
Open Focus mode and choose the apps you want to pause.
Turn it on now or set a schedule that suits you.

resources.string: A planned pause can add a small boundary without removing the apps from your phone.
Set a daily limit for an app you want to use more deliberately.

string-array.name: tip_android_timers_steps
string-array.item: Open Digital Wellbeing and parental controls in Settings.
Open the dashboard and choose an app.
Set a timer you consider realistic, then adjust it if needed.

resources.string: A visible daily boundary may make it easier to notice how long an app has been open.
Keep useful alerts while quieting a category that repeatedly pulls your attention.

string-array.name: tip_android_notifications_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Notifications and App notifications.
Choose an app and review its notification categories.
Turn off only a category you do not need.

resources.string: Fewer unnecessary prompts can leave more choice about when you open an app.
Use Do Not Disturb or another Android mode for a planned quiet period.

string-array.name: tip_android_dnd_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings and find Modes or Do Not Disturb.
Choose which people, apps and alarms may interrupt you.
Turn it on now or set a schedule.

resources.string: Choosing exceptions in advance can reduce interruptions while keeping important alerts available.
Schedule a quieter display and fewer interruptions near bedtime.

string-array.name: tip_android_bedtime_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Modes or Digital Wellbeing.
Choose Bedtime mode and set the days and times.
Review notification and display options before saving.

resources.string: A predictable change in the phone environment may make late-night use easier to notice.
Move a distracting app off the first page
Add a little distance by moving an app away from your first Home screen.

string-array.name: tip_android_move_apps_steps
string-array.item: Touch and hold the app icon on your Home screen.
Drag it to another page, folder or Remove area.
Remember that Remove from Home does not uninstall the app.

resources.string: A small extra step can create time to choose whether you still want to open the app.
Choose times when Instagram notifications should stay quiet.

string-array.name: tip_instagram_sleep_steps
string-array.item: In Instagram, open your profile and the More options menu.
Open Time management, then Sleep mode.
Choose the days and times, then save your changes.

resources.string: A notification-free period may support a boundary you have already chosen.
Tell Instagram when a suggested post is not useful to you.

string-array.name: tip_instagram_hide_steps
string-array.item: Find a suggested post you do not want to see.
Open its three-dot menu or use the visible close control.
Choose Not interested when it is available.

resources.string: Using the service’s own feedback control may reduce similar recommendations over time.
If available, start Instagram recommendations again from a cleaner baseline.

string-array.name: tip_instagram_reset_steps
string-array.item: Open your Instagram profile and the More options menu.
Open Content preferences.
If shown, choose Reset suggested content and review the explanation before confirming.

resources.string: A reset can give you another chance to shape recommendations through later choices and interactions.
Review social-app notification categories instead of silencing everything.

string-array.name: tip_social_notifications_steps
string-array.item: Open Android Settings, then Notifications and App notifications.
Choose a social app and inspect its categories.
Keep important categories and quiet one that is not useful.

resources.string: Selective changes can reduce repeated prompts while preserving alerts you value.
Protect only the apps you choose
Review the protected-app list and keep it focused on the apps you genuinely want covered.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_apps_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings in Impulsive.
Choose apps to protect.
Add or remove apps, then keep the permissions Impulsive needs available.

resources.string: A deliberate list keeps protection aligned with the boundary you intended.
Have one small action ready before a difficult moment arrives.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_plan_steps
string-array.item: Open Moment Plan in Impulsive.
Choose a cue and one realistic next action.
Save the plan and review it when your circumstances change.

resources.string: Preparing a simple action earlier can reduce the number of choices needed in the moment.
Walk through the saved plan once while the moment is calm.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_practise_steps
string-array.item: Open your Moment Plans.
Choose the enabled plan you want to rehearse.
Use Practise and complete the current saved revision.

resources.string: A short rehearsal can make the prepared action more familiar without changing the plan automatically.
Set protection times that reflect when you actually want support.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_schedule_steps
string-array.item: Open Impulsive protection settings.
Review the current protected windows.
Edit and confirm a time only if it suits your routine.

resources.string: A schedule can make the intended boundary available at predictable times while leaving the final choice with you.
Check the existing Website Protection screen and its current VPN status.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_website_steps
string-array.item: Open Website Protection from Home or Settings.
Review its status and supported-browser information.
Change the setting only if you choose to.

resources.string: The status screen keeps website protection and its required VPN state in one place.
Use Reset Reading for a small pause
Choose one short reading when a low-energy action feels more realistic.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_reading_steps
string-array.item: Open Reset Reading from Home.
Choose a short card and read at your own pace.
Let the timer finish, then decide what to do next.

resources.string: A brief, low-demand activity may help create a pause before the next choice.
Use Impulsive Focus for a distraction-free period you choose.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_focus_steps
string-array.item: Open Focus in Impulsive.
Choose a realistic duration and begin when ready.
Review how the period felt when it ends.

resources.string: A defined start and finish can make a focused period easier to approach.
After enough local history exists, look for cautious patterns in past support moments.

string-array.name: tip_impulsive_what_works_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Personal Support.
Choose What Works for Me.
Review only the patterns that have enough on-device evidence.

resources.string: Looking back at cautious summaries may help you decide which support options are worth keeping.
